post.summary: Create a supported cash-sale Draft journal
post.description: Requires AR.SALES_RECEIPT.CREATE in the selected company. Validates active customer/affiliate, BANK member and controlled cash account, a category without a required member, open period and clean attachments. Creates the cash-sale record, normal Manual Draft journal, attachment links, audit, outbox and idempotency receipt atomically. Does not create an AR invoice or allocation. Standard journal approvals and posting remain mandatory; posting checks the receipt against its journal before status writeback. No query parameters or If-Match header.

amount.description: Strictly positive exact decimal string, at most 16 integer and four fractional digits.

201.description: Sales receipt and Manual Draft journal created

get.summary: Read an AP or AR business record by stable identity
get.description: Requires AP.VIEW or AR.VIEW in the selected company. Reads exactly the requested kind and identity across source periods without scanning paginated period lists. Returns exact decimal amounts, current status/revision, explicit journal and source references; null fields remain unavailable, not reconstructed. No command body or command headers.

get.summary: Read recorded credit allocations with source journal trace
get.description: Requires AP.VIEW or AR.VIEW in the subject company. Includes recorded allocation states across all periods. Orders by created timestamp and UUID descending, validates the cursor belongs to this subject, and returns exact decimal amounts. No body, command headers, reservation or write authority.

get.summary: Read recorded credit allocations with source journal trace
get.description: Requires AP.VIEW or AR.VIEW in the subject company. Includes recorded allocation states across all periods. Orders by created timestamp and UUID descending, validates the cursor belongs to this subject, and returns exact decimal amounts. No body, command headers, reservation or write authority.

get.summary: Search posted same-party documents with unreserved balances across source periods
get.description: Derives permission, counterparty and currency from the selected posted credit. Returns posted-ledger-backed documents across source periods using literal search and UUID keyset pagination. Pending payments/receipts reduce available amounts. Context and rows are read under one stable database snapshot. No reservation or command authority; save must recheck current state. No body or command headers.

200.description: Scoped eligible document page and credit context

post.summary: Create an evidence-backed customer refund Draft from posted credit
post.description: Requires AR.REFUND.CREATE. Creates a Manual Draft journal with a customer AR debit and a BANK-controlled cash credit, links verified clean attachments, reserves available posted credit and commits the audit, outbox and actor-bound idempotency receipt atomically. Source credit locking serializes this command with legacy refund and credit allocation commands. Uses the normal separate-actor journal approval and posting workflow. No query parameters or If-Match header.

amount.description: Strictly positive exact decimal string, at most 16 integer and four fractional digits.

200.description: Replay of the same actor-bound refund command

201.description: Refund Draft and attachment evidence created atomically

get.summary: Read scoped posted credit and occupied amounts before allocation or refund
get.description: Requires AP.VENDOR_CREDIT.APPLY, AR.CREDIT_MEMO.APPLY or AR.REFUND.CREATE for the selected action. A single database snapshot includes PENDING/ACTIVE allocations and all non-rejected/non-cancelled refunds. Requires one correctly directed Posted control line identifying the counterparty. Negative remaining capacity is preserved. A closed selected period is returned, not opened. This read reserves nothing; the existing command locks and rechecks all invariants. No body or command headers.

200.description: Scoped credit usage context at one snapshot

get.summary: Read retained payment or receipt history across payment periods
get.description: Requires AP.VIEW for payments or AR.VIEW for receipts in the source company. Newest created record first with stable created_at and UUID keyset ordering. The afterId cursor must belong to the same company, source document and kind. Includes current persisted occurrence and linked journal state, exact monetary strings, and payment-period identity. Read-only; does not create or post. Rejects body, command headers and unknown query fields. Later lifecycle changes appear on refresh; this is not a retained multi-page snapshot.

post.summary: Create an evidence-backed native AP_PAYMENT Draft
post.description: Requires AP.PAYMENT.CREATE. Creates a new MANUAL Draft JE with verified clean company-scoped attachments, payment occurrence and PENDING allocation in one database transaction. The source must have posted journal lineage and positive available balance in this company; the intended payment period must be OPEN and contain date. Requires active BANK-controlled GL and active BANK member. No transfer or automatic Post. Existing AUTO commands remain unchanged. Server derives identity and canonical request hash; idempotency is actor-bound and includes attachment identities. Same-intent replay returns the retained Draft receipt even after subsequent lifecycle changes. Rejects unknown/query fields and If-Match.

amount.description: Strictly positive exact decimal string, at most 16 integer and four fractional digits.

post.summary: Create an evidence-backed native AR_RECEIPT Draft
post.description: Requires AR.RECEIPT.CREATE. Creates a new MANUAL Draft JE with verified clean company-scoped attachments, payment occurrence and PENDING allocation in one database transaction. The source must have posted journal lineage and positive available balance in this company; the intended payment period must be OPEN and contain date. Requires active BANK-controlled GL and active BANK member. No transfer or automatic Post. Existing AUTO commands remain unchanged. Server derives identity and canonical request hash; idempotency is actor-bound and includes attachment identities. Same-intent replay returns the retained Draft receipt even after subsequent lifecycle changes. Rejects unknown/query fields and If-Match.

amount.description: Strictly positive exact decimal string, at most 16 integer and four fractional digits.

get.summary: Search active bank members for payment and receipt Drafts
get.description: Requires AP.PAYMENT.CREATE for AP_PAYMENT or AR.RECEIPT.CREATE for AR_RECEIPT. Entity-scoped active BANK master data. Literal case-insensitive reference/name search, UTF-8 C keyset order, and last visible next_ref when another match exists. Reuse kind/query with afterRef; restart after changing search. Each page reflects current master data. The separate COA reader identifies active BANK-required GL accounts; no bank-to-account relationship is inferred. Creation revalidates chosen masters. No body, command headers, mutations or role grants. AR_REFUND bank selection requires AR.REFUND.CREATE; it does not authorize invoice receipts or bill payments.

get.summary: Read source balance and payment-period context for a settlement Draft
get.description: Requires AP.PAYMENT.CREATE for AP_PAYMENT or AR.RECEIPT.CREATE for AR_RECEIPT. A single database snapshot returns the selected source document and payment period in the authenticated entity. A prior-period source may be settled in a later period; a closed payment period returns can_create_draft=false. AP source eligibility is APPROVED/OPEN/PARTIALLY_PAID; AR is OPEN/PARTIALLY_PAID, mirroring existing commands. Draft reads change no balances or ledger. Creation subsequently locks and revalidates source, period, allocation capacity and selected masters; this read holds no form-duration lock. No command headers/body or mutation.

200.description: Scoped settlement context at one snapshot

open_balance.description: Nonnegative subsidiary open balance; monetary strings preserve four decimal places.

pending_allocation_amount.description: Nonnegative sum of all PENDING allocations against the document, including adjustments.

available_amount.description: open_balance minus PENDING allocations. ACTIVE allocations are already reflected in open_balance. Negative capacity is preserved and ineligible.

can_create_draft.description: Advisory source-state/positive-capacity/open-payment-period eligibility only. Does not authorize posting or guarantee a later command.

get.summary: Search active counterparties for native Bill and Invoice Drafts
get.description: Requires AP.BILL.CREATE for AP_BILL or AR.INVOICE.CREATE for AR_INVOICE. Entity-scoped master data only: active vendors for bills, active customers/affiliates for invoices. Literal case-insensitive search in reference/name. Keyset order uses UTF-8 C collation; next_ref is the last visible reference when another matching row exists. Each page reflects current master data and is not a financial population snapshot. Reuse kind/query with afterRef; restart paging after changing the search. Creation independently revalidates the selected master. No command headers, body, mutations, or automatic role grants.

get.summary: Read immutable entity audit events
get.description: Requires AUDIT.VIEW. Returns a keyset-paged, entity-scoped, metadata-free audit timeline. Raw reason, metadata, request, correlation, and idempotency text are never returned; request references are SHA-256 hashed. This operation cannot create, review, approve, or post accounting records.

get.summary: Read approved entity-period accounting settings
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns a closed presentation of the one approved entity-period settings snapshot and its ten approved policy families. It cannot edit settings, create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: Read immutable approved and retired setting history
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns deterministic keyset pages for one approved accounting setting family. Snapshot bodies and retirement reasons are excluded; only retained lifecycle evidence and direct reference counts are returned. Counts are references, not inferred business usage. This operation cannot edit, create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: Read approved account-to-report mappings
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns the complete account-to-statement and report-row mapping population from the exact approved entity-period settings snapshot. It cannot create, edit, approve, deactivate, import, apply, or post a mapping.

get.summary: Read approved project, property, and cost-code mappings
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns the complete project/property/cost-code dimension-rule population from the exact approved entity-period settings snapshot. It cannot create, edit, approve, deactivate, import, apply, or post a mapping.

get.summary: Read approved vendor treatment mappings
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns the complete vendor treatment-rule population from the exact approved entity-period settings snapshot. It cannot create, edit, approve, deactivate, import, apply, or post a mapping.

get.summary: Read approved tax policy and code mappings
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns the complete tax-code population and approved tax allocation policy from the exact approved entity-period settings snapshot. It cannot create, edit, approve, deactivate, import, apply, calculate a filing, or post accounting.

get.summary: Read approved intercompany counterparty mappings
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns the complete approved intercompany policy and counterparty mapping population from the exact entity-period settings snapshot. It cannot create, edit, approve, deactivate, import, eliminate, settle, create a Draft, or post accounting.

get.summary: Read approved loan-capitalization policy and qualifying combinations
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns the complete approved loan-capitalization policy and qualifying project/property/asset population from the exact entity-period settings snapshot. It cannot classify a transaction, select evidence, create a Draft, review, approve, or post accounting.

get.summary: Read approved thresholds and separation-of-duties workflow controls
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns the complete approved four-stage human workflow and classification-threshold populations from the exact entity-period settings snapshot. Policy roles are evidence, not the caller's runtime grants. This read cannot create a Draft, submit, review, approve, post, grant, or revoke authority.

get.summary: Read the complete approved accounting materiality policy
get.description: Requires AI.ACCOUNTING.SETTINGS.VIEW. Returns every approved monetary, ratio, aging, dormancy, and frequency control from the exact entity-period settings snapshot with canonical policy evidence. This read cannot edit thresholds, create a Draft, review, approve, or post accounting.

get.summary: List the authenticated actor's REFS companies and accounting periods
get.description: Returns only active tenant entities and their accounting periods that are already present in the authenticated database scope. It is read-only, no-store, and accepts no caller-supplied tenant, entity, or permission selector.

get.summary: Tie a signed admitted bank statement to the Posted GL cash balance
get.description: Requires AI analysis authority. Returns only exact entity-period reconciliation evidence bound to an admitted Ed25519-signed statement and Posted Journal and ledger lineage. It cannot match, adjust, create a Draft, review, approve, post, read raw bytes, or invoke a model.

200.description: Closed read-only bank-to-GL balance reconciliation review

Returns deterministic review findings with no Draft, review, approval, posting, or model authority.

post.summary: Persist deterministic vendor invoice amount anomalies
post.description: Recomputes the exact signed-source analysis and atomically appends findings, audit events, outbox events, and an actor-bound idempotency receipt. It grants no Draft, review, approval, or posting authority.

get.summary: Detect unusual vendor invoice frequency and split-invoice risk
get.description: Compares provider-signed retained payable counts across periods within the exact accounting context. Returns every current source trace and grants no accounting authority.

post.summary: Persist deterministic vendor invoice frequency anomalies
post.description: Recomputes the exact signed-source frequency analysis and atomically appends the finding, every source link, audit event, outbox event, and actor-bound idempotency receipt. It grants no accounting authority.

get.summary: Detect materially low vendor invoices and possible missing accruals
get.description: Compares provider-signed retained payable amounts with exact-context history. Returns evidence and required human accrual decisions only; it cannot create or post a journal.

post.summary: Persist deterministic vendor invoice amount-drop findings
post.description: Recomputes exact signed-source analysis and atomically appends findings, audit, outbox, and actor-bound idempotency receipt. Accrual remains an explicit human decision and no accounting action is granted.

get.summary: Detect separately retained invoices with equivalent normalized identities
get.description: Compares provider-signed retained payable evidence in the exact accounting context. It returns two-source evidence and required human duplicate decisions only; it cannot pay, reverse, create, review, approve, or post a journal.

post.summary: Persist deterministic vendor invoice near-duplicate findings
post.description: Recomputes exact signed-source analysis and atomically appends findings, both source traces, audit, outbox, and an actor-bound idempotency receipt. It grants no accounting or payment authority.

get.summary: Detect unsupported or round-amount manual Journal risks
